svg.title: Complete map of Mert's agent infrastructure
svg.desc: Your MacBook and personal accounts stay walled off from agents. You talk to the team through Slack. The DGX Spark hosts the OpenShell sandbox with eight agents and the local models, with scoped revocable agent identities. The CEO calls Claude Opus in the cloud. A git workspace is the bridge between you and the agents.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What exactly stays on my side of the wall, off limits to agents?')
sendPrompt('How do the per-agent Slack bots get wired up safely?')
sendPrompt('How is the Opus CEO call allowlisted and cost-capped?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through the OpenShell sandbox walls around the agents')
sendPrompt('Show me the current vLLM serving configs for both models')
sendPrompt('How do I set up the revocable agent email and GitHub identities?')
sendPrompt('How should the shared workspace folder structure look?')
